headline: Senate resolution that would have let senators consider a group of pending nominations together failed to advance.
what_it_does: This resolution would have allowed the Senate to consider several nominations on its Executive Calendar as one group, called "en bloc," instead of one at a time. The title does not say which nominations were included. On December 4, 2025, the Senate did not agree to move forward with it.

who_it_affects.group: People nominated by the President who were awaiting Senate confirmation
who_it_affects.how: Their nominations would have been considered together as a group rather than through separate votes.
It would have changed how the Senate handled these specific nominations, allowing them to be considered in one step.
